description: Add a one-question-at-a-time (一問一答) answering mode to the public quiz app, in ADDITION to the existing all-at-once (一括表示) mode, letting the user choose the mode when starting a quiz. Both modes share the SAME selected state and SAME submit/result/history path (single submitAnswers call, single QuizResult screen, single history.append). This is the core feature and is entirely within frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx plus a new answering component. It is one coherent unit of work.
steps: In frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx, extend the View state machine to support choosing a mode when starting a quiz. Add a mode state, e.g. `type AnswerMode = 'all' | 'oneByOne'` and `const [mode, setMode] = useState<AnswerMode>('all')`. Decide on a clean UX: a small mode chooser step shown when a quiz is selected (recommended: a new View value 'chooseMode' rendered after loadQuiz, offering two buttons 「一括表示」 and 「一問一答」), OR a lightweight toggle at the top of the answering screen. Do NOT regress the existing all-at-once flow. If adding a 'chooseMode' View, update the View union type accordingly and keep loadQuiz(quizId) as the single fetch entry point (it fetches QuizDetail via getQuiz; only change where it routes after a successful fetch).

Keep the existing QuizTaking component (all-at-once mode) exactly as-is functionally: it renders all questions as `<fieldset className="card question"><legend>Q{n+1}. {text}</legend>` with radio `.option`s, a progress bar 「回答済み X / Y」, and buttons 「一覧に戻る」/「回答する」. It must remain available and unchanged in behavior.

Add a new one-by-one answering component (recommended: a new component `QuizTakingOneByOne` in HomePage.tsx, or a new file frontend/src/pages/QuizTakingOneByOne.tsx imported by HomePage). It receives the same props shape as QuizTaking needs: quiz: QuizDetail, selected: Record<number, number>, onSelect: (questionN, optionIndex) => void, onSubmit: (event) => void, onBack: () => void. Internally it keeps a local `current` index state (0-based into quiz.questions) initialized to 0.

One-by-one behavior: render ONLY quiz.questions[current] at a time inside `<fieldset className="card question"><legend>Q{q.n + 1}. {q.text}</legend>` with the same radio `.option` markup as QuizTaking (name={'q' + q.n}, checked={selected[q.n] === optIdx}, onChange={() => onSelect(q.n, optIdx)}). Show a 「Q {current+1} / {total}」 indicator and reuse the existing `.progress` / `.progress-bar` / `.progress-bar-fill` markup (aria-label on the progress). Provide 「前へ」 (disabled when current === 0) and 「次へ」 buttons to navigate; on the LAST question replace 「次へ」 with a submit button 「回答する」 that triggers onSubmit. Include 「一覧に戻る」 to go back. Navigation must NOT auto-submit; it only moves between questions.

IMPORTANT contract constraint: the public quiz payload has NO answerIndex (scoring is server-side), so do NOT locally grade / mark correct-incorrect mid-quiz and do NOT invent backend calls. Any 「次へ」 affordance only RECORDS the choice via onSelect and advances; the correctness reveal happens only at the END via the existing single submitAnswers call and the existing QuizResult screen. Do not leak answers up front or fabricate local grading.

Preserve unanswered = -1 semantics: onSubmit in HomePage already builds answers via quiz.questions.map(q => q.n in selected ? selected[q.n] : -1). One-by-one mode must allow advancing past a question without selecting (leaving it unanswered = -1). Do not force an answer to advance.

Wire the chosen mode into HomePage's render: when in the answering view, render <QuizTaking .../> if mode === 'all' else <QuizTakingOneByOne .../>, passing the SAME currentQuiz, selected, selectOption, handleSubmit, and onBack={() => setView('list')}. Both modes call the identical handleSubmit, which calls submitAnswers once and records history once. Reset current-index and selected appropriately when a new quiz/mode starts (loadQuiz already does setSelected({}) and setResult(null)).

Accessibility: use a radio group per question (already the pattern via name={'q'+q.n}); put aria on the progress element (aria-label like 「回答の進捗」 or 「Q X / Y」); as a nice touch, move focus to the new question's legend or first option when advancing (e.g. a ref + useEffect on `current`, guarded so it does not steal focus on initial mount unexpectedly). Keep it simple and do not break keyboard use.

Confirm no new imports beyond React hooks and existing modules (api.ts types, history.ts). Do NOT add react-router or any library. Do NOT modify api.ts, history.ts, amplify.yml, backend, or admin page.
acceptance_criteria: The user can choose between 一括表示 (all-at-once) and 一問一答 (one-by-one) when starting a quiz, and the existing all-at-once flow is unchanged and still reachable.
In one-by-one mode, exactly one question is shown at a time with its options and a 「Q X / Y」 indicator; 前へ/次へ navigate without submitting, and the last question offers 回答する.

Both modes build answers with unanswered = -1 and call submitAnswers exactly once, then show the existing QuizResult score-ring screen and record history exactly once (via the existing async submit-success callback in HomePage).
No mid-quiz correctness grading is performed (no answerIndex is used client-side); correctness is only revealed on the result screen from SubmitResult.
frontend dependencies remain exactly react + react-dom; no lockfile is added; api.ts, history.ts, amplify.yml, backend, Cognito/auth, and admin page are untouched.
TSX is valid and type-aligned with api.ts (QuizDetail, SubmitResult) and history.ts (append, makeRecord); imports resolve.
verification: Read HomePage.tsx and the new one-by-one component: confirm the View/mode state machine keeps the all-at-once path intact and routes one-by-one through the same selected state and the same handleSubmit.

Trace the submit path for BOTH modes: confirm a single submitAnswers call, a single append(makeRecord(...)) inside the async success callback, unanswered = -1 mapping, and setView('result') using the existing QuizResult.
Grep the diff for any accidental new dependency, react-router import, answerIndex use mid-quiz, or edits to api.ts/history.ts/amplify.yml/backend/admin; confirm none.

Because INTEGRATIONS_ONLY blocks npm/tsc/vite, note that the user must run `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` on a networked host to confirm the tsc + vite build; author correct-by-construction.
findings: Implemented entirely in frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx. Added 'chooseMode' to the View union and an AnswerMode ('all' | 'oneByOne') state (default 'all'). loadQuiz now routes to 'chooseMode' after fetch (still the single getQuiz entry point); a new startQuiz(mode) sets mode + view='quiz'. New components: ModeChooser (two card buttons 一括表示 / 一問一答) and QuizTakingOneByOne (local `current` index, renders one question, 前へ disabled at 0, 次へ vs 回答する on last, no auto-submit, focus moved to legend via ref+useEffect guarded against initial mount with mountedRef). Both modes pass the SAME selected/selectOption/handleSubmit, so the submit/result/history path is unchanged (single submitAnswers, single append inside async success callback, unanswered=-1 map). QuizTaking left functionally identical. No answerIndex used mid-quiz (only in QuizResult). Added class names for FEAT-002 to style: mode-chooser, mode-chooser-label, mode-options, mode-option, mode-option-title, mode-option-desc, one-by-one. Verification: build/tsc/vite CANNOT run in sandbox (INTEGRATIONS_ONLY, npm registry 403). Verified correct-by-construction by reading: valid TSX, imports resolve (added useRef; React.FormEvent prop type matches existing QuizTaking pattern), types align with api.ts (QuizDetail/SubmitResult) and history.ts (append/makeRecord). Confirmed deps still exactly react + react-dom, no lockfile, and api.ts/history.ts/amplify.yml untouched. User must run `cd frontend && npm install && npm run build` on a networked host. Committed to feat/one-by-one-mode as 9b4d682. FEAT-002 (CSS + README) intentionally NOT done.
